exposure: fifteen-session group psychosocial intervention (Mama Ambassador Program)
outcome: infant developmental outcomes (Ages and Stages Questionnaire - ASQ)
maternal mental well-being (WHO Self-Reporting Questionnaire - SRQ)
cohort: The study included 789 adolescent mothers (446 in the intervention group and 343 in the control group) and their infants from Rakai and Kalisizo Hospitals.
finding: A culturally adapted, group-based psychosocial support program significantly improved infant developmental outcomes across all five ASQ domains at 2, 6, and 12 months, and maternal mental wellbeing at birth and 6 months post-partum among adolescent mothers.
